svg.aria-label: Tool Router Ladder — How small can a tool router go? A research build that distils a 550B teacher's tool-calling into Qwen2.5 0.5B–3B LoRA students on τ²-bench retail, then measures where multi-step agent reliability breaks — across 16/40/80-tool catalogs, SFT vs DPO vs GRPO, and a log-prob confidence router that escalates hard steps back to the teacher.
